literature.title: Impact assessment report accompanying the proposal for a Digital Networks Act
literature.headline: The Regulatory Scrutiny Board first gave the draft a negative opinion, then a positive opinion with reservations.

literature.citation: BEREC (2026), Early BEREC assessment of the Digital Networks Act, BoR (26) 52
literature.title: Early BEREC assessment of the Digital Networks Act
literature.headline: Welcomes the aim of simplifying the framework, but warns the proposal could add operational complexity, administrative burden and legal uncertainty, shifts some powers to the centre, and needs more analysis to keep end-user protections that work today.

literature.citation: Liebhaberg (CERRE) (2026), Future-proofing Europe's digital connectivity: reflections on the Digital Networks Act proposal, CERRE
literature.title: Future-proofing Europe's digital connectivity: reflections on the Digital Networks Act proposal
literature.headline: Draws on CERRE's 2024 work showing very different market outcomes under the same EU framework because of divergent national implementation.
